title: On the residual missing mass of the Bullet Cluster
efc_relevance: Re-confirms a residual missing-mass discrepancy in the Bullet Cluster after the JWST strong+weak lens model; sits directly on top of EFC's sealed JWST Bullet δκ shock-front prediction (figshare 31963668) and supplies a third independent reconstruction to compare against arXiv:2503.21870 and arXiv:2601.22245.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as Bullet δκ sealed-prediction probe; promote Stage-IV Roadmap Bullet pipeline to immediate priority alongside arXiv:2503.21870 and arXiv:2601.22245; cross-reference framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016 (historical Bullet failure) and framework:SIDM-Spergel2000.
